quoted_tweet.text:
We’re rolling out a version of GPT-6.2 Sol in the Chat tab, optimized for everyday conversation.

It’s much better at handling complex requests, especially when you give it detailed instructions or ask it to find information online. 

A few improvements you might notice in everyday chats:
- It picks up on finer details in photos, like text on a label or symbols on a sign.

- When you’re comparing options online, it does a better job of narrowing them down based on what matters to you, like price or location.

- It has a better sense of when to offer a follow-up, like asking if you’d like a heads-up when a price drops.

Rolling out today to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users.

We’re working with Cisco on what we think are going to be key infrastructure primitives in the new era of cybersecurity. 

Everything needs to be built to be operated safely by aligned agents at machine speed.

quoted_tweet.author: OpenAI
quoted_tweet.text:
We’re introducing Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime allowing agents to defend systems without downtime. It lets agents write dynamic eBPF controls to shield systems from exploits, giving defenders more time to test and roll out patches. Built by @cisco together with OpenAI.

Shirudo is a first step toward self-defending infrastructure that can adapt to new threats while keeping services running. Our goal is for defenders to work with AI agents to find affected systems, test and share shields, and deploy them without disrupting workloads.

https://openai.com/index/introducing-shirudo/
